Definite English repairs: 37 English fields (45 exact replacement operations) across 21 units:

- Romanization errors that contradict the chapter's own pinyin or person records: Bei He'ni→Bei Hemi, Bairongzi→Bailongzi, Hu Yu→Huyu, Xiu Ruo→Xiuruo, Wen Jing→Wenjing, Prince Luan/Ren→Prince Ziluan/Ziren, Chen→Chenzhi.

- Mistranslations: 憚直 (s0045) as "blunt honesty"; reversed agency in 坐為尋陽王鞭殺私奴 (s0219); 太宗 rendered with the 世祖 label in the literal field (s0092, s0098); 光祿勳 as "Grand Master of Splendid Hanour" with 追贈 as enfeoffment (s0130, s0156); 君父 as "sovereign and lord" (s0025 idiomatic); "the Mizhi clan" (s0150); "executed" for 見殺 (s0130).
- Attribution: Fan Shuang as "his attendant" right after Lu Shuang falls (s0060).

Dependent extraction updates: 13 claim revisions (including 2 office labels and 1 dismissal reason), 2 person name suggestions and 8 English mention spans (one offset-only), plus native span recomputation for repaired units.

Considered and retained: "Prince Jun" for 世祖 in s0015/s0024/s0026 idiomatic is acceptable "Prince + given name" style for Liu Jun before accession, so it is not changed. 範雙 (p037) and 范雙 (p087) are preserved as separate chunk-local records for canonical resolution.

replacements.reason: 寧朔將軍 is rendered "General Who Pacifies the North", the same English used for 平北將軍 (s0210, s0224) and 安北將軍 (s0225).
